body: Added new Control Modes: Schedule, NFC, QR, and Mixed, including per-channel toggles for supported trigger types
Added in-app limits, website blocking, attempt-based app limits, Settings blocking, and Re-entry
Improved the app with a complete UI rework, including better navigation, customization, onboarding, diagnostics, and support flows
Improved Usage Statistics with drill-down views, website tracking, Website Details screens, interactive charts, better labels, improved sorting, and more accurate time calculations
Improved automation and reliability across schedules, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, NFC, paired tags, watchdog behavior, diagnostics, and profile switching
Improved limits and blocking clarity with clearer blocked reasons, profile indicators, limit badges, and a more polished limits experience overall
Fixed multiple Android 16 issues and other stability problems across schedules, NFC flows, themes, and general app behavior
Fixed theme and custom accent inconsistencies across dialogs, inputs, controls, charts, and other UI elements
Removed older or less reliable integrations such as TikTok/X in-app blocking and Snapchat support
Updated Switchly for better overall performance, cleanup, and consistency across the app
Fixed NFC tag entry issues so NFC-triggered actions/profile changes apply more reliably
Fixed a profile switching issue where Wi-Fi/schedule automation could override the active profile unexpectedly
Removed Snapchat support completely from Switchly (including old Snapchat-specific surfaces/features)
Added some smaller fixes and improvements across the app
Added Switchly Lite info
Fixed 'Blocked right now' status updating instantly when attempts run out, and added clearer blocked reasons (time limit, attempts limit, profile block)
Improved statistics charts: added better X-axis labeling, prevented popups while dragging, and ensured chart popups use the custom accent (no more default green OK)
Reworked limits UX: cleaner quick limit editor with Clear Limit, tappable limit cards, side-by-side Time/Attempts display, and clearer wording (e.g., Opens today)
Website limits: fixed the '0 minutes' bug (no longer creates a fake limit), and added an explicit 'Block always' option for domains
Profile clarity improvements: visible profile indicator when editing limits + per-row limit badges showing how each app/website is restricted
Removed ghost entries: uninstalled apps are no longer shown in Blocking/Statistics lists

Custom color consistency pass: unified dialog button style app-wide (account-popup style), fixed green checkboxes/radios/filters, fixed green cursor blink in text inputs, and polished schedule weekday spacing/colors
NFC/Paired tags polish: kept NFC writer visible when paired tags are disabled, updated 'actions explained' info text depending on enabled/disabled state, and improved paired tag edit dialog actions
Billing stability: mitigated a rare Google Play Billing ProxyBillingActivity crash by gating/enabling it only during real purchase flows
Added App Limit option: limit by attempts (number of launches)
Fixed custom color rendering for uninstalled apps (e.g., in lists/entries)
Minor UI/design adjustments and polish
General bug fixes and stability improvements
Fixed Statistics FAB filter icon color in dark mode (uses correct tint/styling)
Improved website usage tracking reliability (better handling when leaving/returning via Recents)
Added Website Details screen (weekly usage view + per-site stats)
Added usage range selector in Details: Week/Month/Year (+ Overall history)
Details now open on the same range you selected in Statistics (Week/Month/Year/Overall)
Added interactive charts: tap bars/points to see exact usage values and timestamps
Improved chart display to avoid confusing decimal hours (uses time format like 3:38 instead of 3.6h)
Reworked Overall history charts to show consistent monthly timeline (fills missing months and avoids empty series on some devices)
Website Details UI polish: moved Blocking settings next to Daily limit controls
Website delete action moved to top bar (trash icon) for better privacy/accessibility
Added website data deletion option (clear tracked usage; optional rule/limit cleanup)
Updated Firebase BOM to latest patch version (34.10.0)
Fixed Android lint issues (app:tint usage, KTX improvements, reduced allocations in custom chart drawing)
General cleanup: minor resource/layout lint adjustments and code tidying

Updated NFC Writer dropdown UI (opened dropdown width matches field instead of full screen width)
Added sorting to Manage Paired NFC screen
